name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2165: A cross-family review of v2163 found two breaks I had shipped, both severe and both invisible to the guards I wrote alongside them. THE BOARD SCRIPT DID NOT PARSE: v2163 appended the totals helpers INSIDE the JSON.stringify object literal, right after route:route, so the whole script was a SyntaxError and board_ownership answered ok false to EVERY caller, the tally, the world-identity remember and the doctor. Parse-time, so the function own try catch never ran and the helper try catch was theatre. My guard grepped the PYTHON source for the key names and found them, because the strings were there, and a string being present is not a script that parses. THE EVIDENCE ROUTE NEVER RECEIVED THE NAME: do_GET strips the query before dispatch, so urlparse of the stripped path always yielded empty and every request answered no name given while the UI fetched a perfectly good URL, dead on arrival and wired-looking from both ends. Both guards now verify the THING: the parse guard intercepts the real script on its way to the window and runs node check on it, after two earlier attempts failed on their own reconstruction, once on words quoted inside a comment and once on a branch the regex flattened. The relocation was settled by co_consts rather than by line numbers, which disagreed with the compiled truth.
